question: A unit must publish a policy report. Tasks can run in parallel as soon as all their prerequisites are complete, and there are enough staff to work on any number of tasks at once. What is the minimum number of working days needed to complete everything?
explanation: Earliest finish of each task = its duration + the latest finish among its prerequisites: Collect data 6; Draft analysis 12; Legal check 16; Translation 18; Layout 24; Final approval 29. The longest chain (the critical path) is Collect data → Draft analysis → Translation → Layout → Final approval, so the project needs 29 days. Typical errors: adding all durations (33) wrongly assumes that nothing runs in parallel; following a shorter branch underestimates the time; forgetting the final task, or adding a parallel task in series, also gives a wrong total.
